params.body:
## What was wrong

A new post opens in the Studio laid out in its sections: Signal, Why It Matters, Examples, How To Activate It, with Monday: and This quarter: under it (`POST_SECTIONS` in gentells-studio `src/piece.js`). The writing partner still described a post as "short paragraphs, a section or two under `## ` headings, and a brand implication". A first draft it wrote came in headings of its own, beside the layout instead of in it, and the writer had to re-section it by hand.

## What changes

The post line in `piece-prompt.mjs`:
- names the sections in order, spelled as the Studio lays them out, with what goes in each, and the Monday: and This quarter: subheadings carrying their move after the colon, as on the live posts;
- says a heading is a line of its own with a blank line after it, since a heading with its text on the next line is what the editor had trouble with;
- says text for a section the piece does not have yet starts with that heading, and a first draft is one block per section, which keeps it within the eight blocks a first draft may have.

The Studio recognises a section by its level and the words its heading starts with, so a draft written this way lands in its place. A comment at the prompt points at `POST_SECTIONS`: a change of structure is an edit in both.

Articles and decks are unchanged.

## Checked

- `test/piece-talk.test.mjs`: every section heading named, in order, as the Studio spells it; the heading-on-its-own-line rule; the article shape untouched. Both new cases fail on main.
- Full suite: 1591/1591.
- Not run against the model here. The writer's next first draft in the Studio is the check.

Safe to merge alone; no Studio or site change needed.
params.title: The writing partner writes a post in its sections
